'''House Mitsobar''' is a [[nobility|noble]] house of [[Altara]].

==History==
House Mitsobar became the ruling house of Altara when [[Tylin Quintara Mitsobar]] was crowned queen of Altara. Because of Altara's autonomous nature, the monarch's power does not extend much beyond the borders of the capital of [[Ebou Dar]].

==Sigil==
House Mitsobar's sigil is a green anchor and sword, crossed, on a white background.{{ref/book|8|1}}

==Activities==
When the [[Seanchan]] invaded Altara in {{Ne|1000}} as part of the ''[[Corenne]]'', [[High Lady|High Ladies]] [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] and [[Suroth Sabelle Meldarath]] are welcomed by Queen Tylin.{{ref/book|9|17}} Both of the Seanchan women tell Tylin that her rule will soon expand to all of Altara. When Tylin is killed, her son [[Beslan Mitsobar]] becomes King of Altara and [[High Seat]] of House Mitsobar.{{ref/book|11|p}}
